svg.text: Explore Egypt | Logical data model v2 | PK = primary key, FK = foreign key, UQ = unique
Scope rules: one primary category per place in the MVP; use a join table later if multi-category tagging is needed. Bookings reference a specific departure.
Company access is mapped through CompanyMembers. For a simpler first implementation, enforce one primary member per company. Fees/facilities are optional verified records.
